From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rajesh Menon <rajesh.m@vectra.ai>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + two outstanding questions — next steps?

Hi Sophie — great to meet you and Rajesh earlier. Quick recap from our 30-minute discovery so we’re aligned and to make the next steps easy:

What I heard:
- You’re evaluating options to standardize inference for a set of LLM-powered features (search rerank + summaries) across prod and staging, target latency P50 < 120ms for 512 tokens.
- Primary constraints: predictable cost, SOC2 compliance, and ability to run in your VPC for PII subsets.
- Short timeline: pilot in Q3 with potential production in Q4 if the pilot performance/cost looks good.

Two outstanding technical questions I couldn’t answer on the call — if you can confirm either here or loop Rajesh in, that’ll help us scope the right trial setup:
1) Traffic shape: do you expect a steady stream of small single-request hits (~1–2 prompts/sec) or more bursty traffic with occasional 100+ reqs/min spikes? Even a rough daily peak helps.
2) Data residency: for the pilot, will you need the private deployment (VPC) option, or is Dedicated (Redwood-managed in your cloud account) acceptable?

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll put together a short pilot plan (1–2 week smoke test) with cost estimates for Dedicated vs Private.
- Rajesh, if you can share approximate peak QPS and whether the PII path needs VPC, I’ll include the right infra proposal.
- If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min technical workshop next week to walk through KV-cache, batching, and volume-based config.

I attached a short demo packet with model performance profiles and a sample pilot scope (redwood-demo-pkg.pdf). If you’re available, what windows look good for a workshop next Tue/Wed afternoon PT?

Thanks — Marcus

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the recap and the packet. Quick answers: 

- Traffic: Our current estimate for the pilot is ~25 qps steady for peak daytime hours with the potential for 3–5x burst from async workloads. We can provide a rough hourly histogram if that helps.
- Data residency: For the pilot we prefer Redwood Dedicated (managed) to move quickly; depending on audit feedback we may request VPC for prod.

I’ll see if Rajesh can make the workshop; he’s heads down but should be able to share the histogram you mentioned. For now, please draft the pilot plan and cost delta between Dedicated and Private. Also include any preflight checklist we need to complete (SOC2 evidence, IP allowlist).

Best — Sophie
